d: Long, flowing dusty purple hair is styled into two high voluminous pigtails with long bangs framing a youthful, mature face. Golden-amber eyes have a sharp, confident expression. The build is slender, dressed in a dark charcoal and crimson outfit featuring a high collar, gold metallic accents, and black fingerless gloves. Signature details include black ribbons securing the pigtails with gold floral ornaments and a gold choker around the neck.
